text:
anya-sec: Scan found an old snapshot retained by partner staging that includes Vault ciphertexts encrypted with a deprecated KMS key (version 2). Also includes a service account JSON. Starting containment.

 tom-oncall: Please post the object path and any sample filenames.

 anya-sec: s3://partner-staging-archives/service-agent-snap-2026-05-02.tar.gz. Inside: agent.log, dump.env, agent-sa.json, and a few `vault:v1:` blobs.

 vikram-eng: Confirmed. Risk: partner may still have copies and the old KEK could allow offline rewrap if they exfiltrate.

 rachel-devops: Immediate actions I'll run:
```
# block agent ingestion from that bucket
aws s3api put-bucket-policy --bucket partner-staging-archives --policy file://deny-agent.json
# revoke sa key found
gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete KEY_PLACEHOLDER --iam-account=agent-sa@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```

 anya-sec: Also please revoke Vault tokens that match prefix `agent-temp-`.

 tom-oncall: Done. Ran `vault token revoke -prefix agent-temp-2026` and added a short-lived deny policy for `agent-stager` in Vault.

 compliance-bot: Created incident record INC-2026-0523. Retention export configured to gs://redwood-audit/INC-2026-0523/.

 vikram-eng: Plan: 1) Create new KEK version in KMS. 2) Grant `vault-proxy` decrypt/encrypt on new version. 3) Dry-run `vault operator rewrap` for affected paths. 4) Canary rewrap on a single node. 5) Full rewrap if canary passes.

 rachel-devops: I opened infra PR to add key version + IAM grant and a k8s Job to run rewrap with `--dry-run` flag first. PR: https://git.redwood.dev/r/infra/pull/823

 anya-sec: Partner-ops: @partner-ops please confirm if you control any additional copies; we need secure delete and attest. CC legal.

 partner-ops: We'll locate and scrub copies. ETA 3 hours for sweep and attest. Will DM legal for retention record.

 tom-oncall: RBAC mitigation: temporarily removed S3 read for `agent-ingest-role` and added condition to block older agent user agents. Also prepared fallback routing to hosted tier if tokens expire unexpectedly.

 vikram-eng: Scheduling: key create (5m), grant (5m), dry-run rewrap (10m), canary (15m), full run (30-45m). Will stream rewrap logs to gs://redwood-audit/INC-2026-0523/logs/.

 anya-sec: Owners: anya-sec (partner + legal), rachel-devops (infra + revoke), vikram-eng (rewrap), tom-oncall (RBAC + oncall). I'll update incident with checklist. Close after audit export + partner attestation + regtests. :white_check_mark:
